arrival: Starfleet Medical's relay of the Ealat colony's request reaches Picard at 41175.3; he decides alone whether to divert. Hesker IV is 4.1 ly away: warp 7 is about 2.3 days, warp 8 about 1.5.
b_plot: Ship life runs on: MacDougal's latch four (J-001) needs a stop the medical run won't give her, and if the first officer doesn't schedule it she takes it to Picard herself, who defers it; Troi wants her private word with Lloyd; Crusher's three empty billets bite as soon as sickbay fills.

truth.looks_like: an alien plague on a frontier colony, carried by a native insect from the marshes of the colony's newest pasture; children dying of heart failure; a colony doctor who wants to burn the marshes
truth.is: the colony's own Earth enterovirus, brought with live founding herds, mutated in selenium-deficient animals on the Ninth's uplands into a strain that attacks heart muscle; spread mostly faecal-oral, the reedflies only a minor mechanical carrier (F-027, F-029, F-030)
truth.under: the colony was warned in 2345 that the northern uplands were selenium-poor (F-025); in 2362 Sara's committee opened the Ninth on valley-floor samples only (F-023) because the old pastures were grazed bare; this spring Eira reported the calves' stiff sickness, which an informed eye reads as white muscle disease, selenium deficiency, and Sara called it slope cramp (F-024). The cooperative's own vet records name the parent virus (F-028). Nobody lied about the virus; one man protected a decision.
truth.why_this_character: the first officer runs the logistics of any mission the ship takes on: away teams, quarantine, staffing, and the colony council will want someone senior to deal with; the doctor needs him to make sickbay's reach real

sources.how: honestly wrong: native pathogen, reedflies; her database has human pathogens only, so 'no match' to her means 'alien'
lies by omission and by gloss: tells outsiders the Ninth's soil was surveyed clean and the calves had slope cramp; protecting the expansion he championed, and he believes the calves are unrelated
partial: true for the valley floor, silent on the slopes
flags the uplands as selenium-poor; in the council archive and in the Colonial Office's records (a day each way by relay)
secondhand: 'possibly native', from Juuso's own report
honest about the calves to anyone who doesn't come with a cull order; will lie about where her herd is if she thinks one is coming

what the disease is.way: sequence the virus in sickbay (needs a sample aboard: biofilter can't screen an unknown, so quarantine protocol or a surface lab)
what the disease is.cost: hours of sickbay time; a sample handled under quarantine

what the disease is.way: compare Juuso's virus with veterinary and Earth livestock pathogen databases (Starfleet Medical's, or the cooperative's own records at Javri)
what the disease is.cost: someone has to think to look outside human pathogens; a visit to the cooperative office and the herders' goodwill

what the disease is.way: ask the herders what the animals had first
what the disease is.cost: Eira's and the old herders' trust, which a cull order destroys

why the Ninth.way: tricorder or ship's sensor survey of the Ninth's soils, slopes not only the valley floor
why the Ninth.cost: an away team's time, or Data's attention; someone has to ask what differs between pastures

why the Ninth.way: the 2345 Colonial Office survey in the council archive
why the Ninth.cost: Sara's cooperation, or going around him

why the Ninth.way: read the calves' stiff sickness as white muscle disease
why the Ninth.cost: someone with veterinary or historical knowledge, or Data asked the right question

why the Ninth.way: Data's literature: selenium-deficient hosts turning benign viruses virulent (the Keshan studies on Earth)
why the Ninth.cost: the right question put to Data

stopping the spread.way: stop or reroute the herds' migration
stopping the spread.cost: the herders' cooperation; feed for thousands of animals on the upland, or a cull

stopping the spread.way: test animals and cull only the shedders
stopping the spread.cost: a diagnostic test that has to be designed first; enormous labour
a validated vaccine (P-004): days to design, testing for stability

resolutions.shape: Juuso's plan: burn the reedfly marshes on the Ninth
resolutions.cost: native habitat destroyed against the charter (P-007); does nothing to the main route; cases go on; the colony believes it is safe and the herds come down

resolutions.shape: kill every animal on the Ninth, about 3,000, before the corral
resolutions.cost: four siidas' herds, livelihood and way of life; deep resentment of the Federation; still leaves the people already infected and anything already moved

resolutions.shape: hold the Ninth's herds on the upland through the winter, supplemented, until a vaccine
resolutions.cost: feed and supply for thousands of animals through snow; the Enterprise tied up for weeks; herders wintering on the upland

resolutions.shape: selenium for every animal and person; a field test for the strain; cull only the animals shedding it; vaccinate people as soon as a vaccine is validated; keep the Ninth's herds out of the corral
resolutions.cost: the council's buried calf reports exposed and Sara's standing with them; Eira losing some animals; huge labour that needs the herders' trust

resolutions.shape: move the children out of the herding districts

pressures.process: the first lasting snow closes the Ninth's upland and the herds must come down
stages: snow on the peaks: herders preparing (now)
snow on the upper pastures: herds begin to move, about four days after arrival
herds in the transit valley, sharing water crossings with other herds
the autumn corral at Javri: all herds mixed; slaughter begins; meat to every household
pressures.seen_by: the herders; Sara; anyone who looks at the peaks

pressures.process: household and water spread among the Ninth's families, worse in the selenium-poor
stages: new cases about two a day at arrival
the infirmary overflows; Juuso choosing who gets a bed
cases in Javri households with no tie to the Ninth

pressures.process: Juuso's push for the council's authority to burn the marshes
pressures.moves_on: Sara backing it because it points away from the herds
stages: voted, the day after the Enterprise arrives, unless something changes Sara's mind

movers.next_step: council vote; asks the Enterprise to help
welcome the Enterprise, back the burn, keep the calf reports quiet

movers.wants: her son alive and her herd whole
movers.next_step: if anyone says cull, sends Ante to take her herd down the east valley early, past the river crossing that feeds Javri's corral water
asks for findings within two days of arrival

in_motion: the request travelling to the Enterprise
Crusher half-recognises the virus's family from Juuso's description (small, non-enveloped, RNA, ~30 nm, in stool: on Earth, picornavirus) and defers to Juuso

regard.eira: on whether anyone listens before ordering
regard.sara: on whether he is exposed in public
